harness.comparison: raw source root/property assignment versus San Data.set without force/silent options
harness.accessorCoverage: Pure getters and stable getter/setter only; snapshot getter reads are not a proof of arbitrary accessor side effects.

coverage_obligations.requirement: Native Vue descriptor/observation behavior and original accessor receiver/order must be preserved; rejecting all accessor inputs is not equivalent.

coverage_obligations.scope: Ref/skip markers, Symbol properties and non-standard prototypes
coverage_obligations.requirement: Distinguish false markers, raw-skipped values and actual Ref unwrapping. No key/marker blacklist may silently waive the source API contract.
Separate native assignment acceptance and observation eligibility; retain object identity, no cloning to empty objects.
For the explicitly tested raw-assignment mapping, preserve identity and notification policy for new keys. San-specific silent/force policies have no assumed source counterpart.

Cleanup is compared separately, not dropped. Source beforeDestroy reports through its framework; San disposal may escape directly. Async watcher reporting scope alone does not prove lifecycle-error equivalence.
